s3362365b42cb11: HAMi (heterogeneous AI calculation virtualization) is an open-source platform for managing the Heterogeneous AI computing device in the Kubernetes cluster. Formerly k8s-vGPU-scheduler, Hami can share the equipment between multiple containers and work loads.
s28b00f93ea52fb: HAMi is the Sandbox project of the CCCF and is recorded in the CNCF technology panorama and the CCNAI technology panoramic.

sce832b8370a7e2: Hard limits: enforcing strict memory restrictions in containers to prevent resource conflicts
sfaadc1efbe0a59: Dynamical distribution: distribution of equipment memory according to needs based on workload requirements
s008440ea7f8d01: Flexible units: support the designation of memory allocations in MB or as a percentage of total equipment memory
